paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between decoding temperature and uncertainty estimations for three different metrics: AU (red line with circle markers), TU (blue line with circle markers), and EU (green line with circle markers). The x-axis represents the decoding temperature, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in linear increments of 0.2, labeled as "Decoding Temperature". The y-axis, which is linear and ranges from 0.000 to 0.175 in increments of 0.025, represents the uncertainty estimation values. For AU and TU, the values remain relatively flat and close to 0.125 at lower decoding temperatures (0.0 to 0.4), then increase steadily, reaching approximately 0.175 at a decoding temperature of 0.8. The EU metric remains constant at 0.000 across all decoding temperatures, indicated by a flat green line along the bottom of the plot. The lines for AU and TU are nearly overlapping, suggesting similar behavior, while EU shows no variation with changes in decoding temperature.
